The Chinese characters for Audrey

As a transliteration, Audrey is usually written 奥德丽 (Ào dé lì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With English origins, Audrey is usually read as “noble strength”.

About the name Audrey

The actress Audrey Hepburn gave the name its elegant charm.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Audrey as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “noble strength”, is part of the appeal.
